items: Employees who travel on short notice may be eligible ____ reimbursement of approved taxi expenses.
The adjective 'eligible' takes 'for' before a benefit or reimbursement.
The logistics manager said that a shortage of drivers contributed ____ the delivery delays.
The verb 'contribute' takes 'to' before a result or situation.
The launch date remains dependent ____ final approval from the safety committee.
Several recent warranty claims were associated ____ a defective power connector.
New supervisors are expected to participate ____ a two-day leadership workshop next month.
The verb 'participate' takes 'in' before an activity or event.
Two directors chose to abstain ____ voting because of a potential conflict of interest.
The verb 'abstain' takes 'from' before a noun or gerund.
Customers can subscribe ____ monthly billing alerts through the account portal.
The verb 'subscribe' takes 'to' before a service or publication.
The data center recovered ____ the brief power outage without losing any customer records.
The verb 'recover' takes 'from' before an adverse event or condition.
Orders placed before Friday may qualify ____ free express delivery.
The verb 'qualify' takes 'for' before a benefit or eligibility category.
The procurement team is currently engaged ____ negotiations with three equipment suppliers.
The expression 'be engaged in' takes 'in' before an activity.
The orientation program consists ____ three online modules and one in-person session.
The verb 'consist' takes 'of' before the components of something.
All replacement parts must conform ____ the technical standards listed in the service manual.
The verb 'conform' takes 'to' before a standard or requirement.
The customer relations unit will deal ____ complaints that require a manager's review.
The expression 'deal with' takes 'with' before the matter being handled.
The revised routing system should result ____ shorter delivery times for rural customers.
The expression 'result in' introduces the outcome of a cause or action.
Investigators concluded that the billing discrepancy stemmed ____ an outdated tax table.
The expression 'stem from' introduces the source or cause of a problem.
The final construction cost may differ ____ the preliminary estimate because material prices have risen.
The verb 'differ' takes 'from' when comparing two things.
Please refer ____ the attached schedule for the dates of the regional training sessions.
The verb 'refer' takes 'to' before the document or source being consulted.
The maintenance team relies ____ a local supplier for emergency replacement parts.
Part-time staff will also benefit ____ the company's expanded health-care program.
The verb 'benefit' takes 'from' before the source of an advantage.
A technical specialist will respond ____ your inquiry within two business days.
The verb 'respond' takes 'to' before an inquiry or request.
Online subscriptions now account ____ nearly half of the magazine's annual revenue.
The expression 'account for' means to constitute a stated share or proportion.
The revised checklist is aimed ____ reducing errors during the final inspection.
The expression 'be aimed at' takes 'at' before a noun or gerund.
The manufacturer is committed ____ improving the energy efficiency of its new models.
The adjective 'committed' takes 'to' before a noun or gerund.
The sales team succeeded ____ securing a three-year contract with the hospital network.
The verb 'succeed' takes 'in' before a noun or gerund.
The department head did not approve ____ the consultant's proposal to remove the final review step.
The expression 'approve of' means to consider an idea or action acceptable.
